randomDrift.interpretation: Six LLM seeds per round are a small paired sample. Baseline Wilson intervals describe baseline Monte Carlo precision, not a six-run predictive acceptance band. Compare LLM Wilson intervals as well. Entropy, waits and pattern-language flags are descriptive, not causal proof of hallucination. Pure random is exogenous and independent across attempts; no early stopping. It is a bounded Markov process with heading persistence, so learning state-dependent probabilities is legitimate; absence of a periodic template does not make the reference-policy success rates an information-theoretic ceiling.

definitions.meanAttempts: Mean first-success attempt among seeds that succeeded; unsuccessful seeds are reported separately. Restricted mean treats no success as cap; random execution still always consumes 5 attempts.
definitions.prediction: Joint next position AND heading; visibility at action input. PEEK affects the following observation. Age counts ticks since the last legal sighting within the current attempt.
definitions.cohorts: Main accuracy and action entropy pool recorded actions, so phases/attempt durations and early stopping affect denominators. Age 4+ is not necessarily a monotonic degradation curve.
definitions.omitted: pure_random interactive deliberately not run (optional cost slice). Unknown prompts contain no mode IDs, true rules, seeds, future truth or correctness feedback. Omniscient verification alone receives the current true transition rule and counters.
